title: Pathogenwatch
description: Pathogenwatch is a web-based platform for genomic surveillance of microbial pathogens. It supports analysis and visualization of pathogen genomes with phylogenetic, geographic and epidemiologic context.
practicalUse: Public health genomics users can upload or review pathogen genome data, place sequences in broader genomic context and generate interpretable outputs for surveillance, cluster investigation and reporting.
formatDetails: Web-based genomic surveillance and visualization platform.
legacyTags: Conservative tagging applied because supported organisms and features may vary by pathogen module.
